text:
Rina: Heads-up: Sam (contractor) submitted notice. Contract end date 2025-03-31. Hes on a sponsored visa and has a company-issued air-gapped laptop + HSM token. Need coordinated offboard checklist: invoice finalization, equipment return (on-prem handling), visa sponsorship stop, and secrets rotation.

Sam: Confirmed. I'll finish docs and hand over the monitoring playbook. I have one on-call rotation on 3/29 but can shadow replacement earlier. I can drop the laptop at the Mumbai office or hand it to courier (prefer courier).

Arjun: Thanks. Please add service ownership notes to the RFC repo and list any service account access. Also indicate any scheduled cron jobs that only you monitor.

Diego (IT Ops): For air-gapped devices we need an MDM wipe on-prem; courier won't be able to remote-wipe. If Sam drops at office, we'll do physical check + HSM zeroize before shipping back to asset pool. If courier, we require in-person handoff to our office agent.

Priya (Security): Important: HSM token must be zeroized on-site and rotated for any systems it accessed. Also rotate any customer API keys Sam had. We'll require a signed confirmation of key rotation.

Sam: I used the HSM only for signing deployment artifacts and one prod key for the edge router (service-edge-prod). I'll list exact key aliases in the handoff doc.

Rina: Visa note 1: VisaCoordBot will trigger termination paperwork. Sam, HR needs your last working day confirmation and passport copy to stop sponsorship by 2025-04-05 to avoid overstay.

VisaCoordBot: Reminder: For sponsored contractors, employer must file termination notice within 7 days of last working day. Please provide copy of passport and intended leaving date.

Cam (Payroll): Invoices: Sam please upload final invoice for March by 2025-04-02. We'll process final contractor payment in the following pay cycle. If there are travel reimbursements, attach receipts.

Sam: Uploaded invoice v3 (link in drive). No outstanding travel receipts.

BenefitsBot: Contractors are not eligible for company benefits, but we provide local statutory notices for sponsored visa termination and any final tax forms. People Ops will DM country-specific guidance.

Rina: Offboard checklist draft (everyone please ack and add gaps):
- Sam: RFC handoff + list of cron jobs + final invoice (due 4/2)
- Diego: Asset pickup plan (on-site zeroize) or courier label + chain-of-custody doc
- Priya: Rotate HSM keys + service credentials + confirm customer key rotations
- Cam: Process final invoice and contractor payout schedule
- VisaCoordBot/People Ops: File termination notice and provide exit visa steps
- Arjun: Assign interim oncall and archive runbooks

Diego: I'll schedule an on-prem pickup window 2025-04-03 10:00-12:00 IST. If Sam prefers courier, we'll only accept shipment to the Mumbai office and require the signed chain-of-custody form.

Sam: I'll do office drop on 4/3 10:30 IST then.

Priya: Once zeroize is done well upload the signed confirmation to this thread and lock related vault paths. Also ensure Terraform state doesn't reference any raw keys.

Arjun: I'll update runbooks and handoff on 3/25 and add temporary access for replacement through a short-lived role.

Rina: Exit interview: Sam would you prefer quick async form or 20-min call?

Sam: Async form is fine.

Rina: Cool. I'll send the form and the local visa termination checklist. Everyone, add any missing items by EOD 2025-03-20. Thanks! :handshake:
